{"candidate_rtl":"module alu_64bit(\n    input [63:0] a, b,\n    input [2:0] Oper,\n    output reg [63:0] sum\n);\n    wire is_sub = (~Oper[2]) & (~Oper[1]) & Oper[0];\n    wire is_reverse = (~Oper[2]) & Oper[1] & (~Oper[0]);\n    wire [63:0] arithmetic_a = is_reverse ? b : a;\n    wire [63:0] arithmetic_b = is_reverse ? ~a : (is_sub ? ~b : b);\n    wire [63:0] arithmetic_result = arithmetic_a + arithmetic_b + {{63{1'b0}}, (is_sub | is_reverse)};\n\n    always @(*) begin\n        case (Oper)\n            3'b000, 3'b001, 3'b010: sum = arithmetic_result;\n            3'b011: sum = a | b;\n            3'b100: sum = a & b;\n            3'b101: sum = a ^ b;\n            3'b110: sum = a ~^ b;\n            default: sum = 64'b0;\n        endcase\n    end\nendmodule","bottleneck":"The critical path is the selected add/subtract datapath, consisting of operation-controlled operand inversion/swapping followed by the 64-bit carry-propagating adder and final result selection.","rewrite":"Removed the unused internal carry output, consolidated the three arithmetic operations into one shared adder, and retained a direct decode for the four logic operations and the zero default.","expected_timing_gain":"Expected modest improvement from eliminating redundant arithmetic structures and reducing arithmetic-result selection complexity; the carry-propagation delay remains dominant.","area_or_other_cost":"Shared arithmetic hardware should reduce mapped area and preserve substantial margin below the area cap. Operation decode and operand-control muxing add small front-end logic, with no storage or additional outputs.","functional_boundaries":"For every binary value of a, b, and Oper, the low 64-bit result matches the original. Oper 000, 001, and 010 implement a+b, a-b, and b-a respectively; 011, 100, 101, and 110 implement OR, AND, XOR, and XNOR; all other values produce zero. The original internal c_out is not externally observable and is omitted."}
